reason_for_change: Adds a two-mana Plan that rewards every creature you control that connives and converts the sixth plan counter into four cards, with any number of spells cast for free.
commander_identity_rationale: Directly amplifies Doctor Doom’s guaranteed combat connive and stacks with Kang, Leader, M.O.D.O.K., Baron Strucker and Lethal Scheme.
role_impact: Adds counters to conniving creatures and a powerful delayed card/tempo burst.
power_level_impact: Low initial cost; payoff takes six connive events and is vulnerable to enchantment removal before payoff.
oracle_rules_verification: Current Oracle checked: each creature you control that connives gets a +1/+1 counter and adds a plan counter; sixth counter sacrifices the Plan, exiles top four, casts any number of spells free and puts the rest into hand.

reviewer_notes: The commander alone supplies one connive each combat; other connive effects accelerate the payoff.

reason_for_change: Trades a two-mana black mana rock and a seven-mana tap/exile recursion activation for a low-cost commander-triggered Plan payoff.
commander_identity_rationale: Preserves land-discard and connive core; removes a high-mana secondary recursion engine.
role_impact: Loses a black mana source and repeatable reanimation engine; gains a low-cost connive payoff that can cast spells for free.
power_level_impact: Explicit long-game recursion versus proactive commander synergy trade; no measured win-rate claim.
